proof_body:
by
  intro f ω₁ ω₂ hf h1 him p1 p2
  have hP1 : Function.Periodic f ω₁ := p1
  have hP2 : Function.Periodic f ω₂ := p2
  set g : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun x => f ((x.1 : ℂ) * ω₁ + (x.2 : ℂ) * ω₂) with hg
  have hgc : Continuous g := by
    apply hf.continuous.comp
    fun_prop
  have hK : IsCompact (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hgc.continuousOn
  have hb : Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range f) := by
    refine (Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_closedBall 0).mpr ⟨M, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
    simp only [mem_closedBall_zero_iff]
    set τ := ω₂ / ω₁ with hτ
    set t : ℝ := (z / ω₁).im / τ.im with ht
    set s : ℝ := (z / ω₁).re - t * τ.re with hs
    have hz : z = (s : ℂ) * ω₁ + (t : ℂ) * ω₂ := by
      have h2 : ω₂ = τ * ω₁ := by rw [hτ]; field_simp
      have h3 : z / ω₁ = (s : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * τ := by
        apply Complex.ext
        · simp [hs]
        · simp [ht]; field_simp
      calc z = (z / ω₁) * ω₁ := by field_simp
        _ = _ := by rw [h3, h2]; ring
    have hfz : f z = g (Int.fract s, Int.fract t) := by
      simp only [hg]
      have e : z = ((Int.fract s : ℝ) : ℂ) * ω₁ + ((Int.fract t : ℝ) : ℂ) * ω₂ + (⌊s⌋ • ω₁ + ⌊t⌋ • ω₂) := by
        rw [hz]
        have es : (s : ℂ) = ((Int.fract s : ℝ) : ℂ) + (⌊s⌋ : ℂ) := by
          have := Int.fract_add_floor s
          exact_mod_cast this.symm
        have et : (t : ℂ) = ((Int.fract t : ℝ) : ℂ) + (⌊t⌋ : ℂ) := by
          have := Int.fract_add_floor t
          exact_mod_cast this.symm
        simp only [zsmul_eq_mul]
        nth_rw 1 [es]
        nth_rw 1 [et]
        ring
      rw [e]
      rw [← add_assoc, hP2.zsmul]
      rw [hP1.zsmul]
    rw [hfz]
    exact hM _ ⟨⟨Int.fract_nonneg s, (Int.fract_lt_one s).le⟩, ⟨Int.fract_nonneg t, (Int.fract_lt_one t).le⟩⟩
  exact fun z w => hf.apply_eq_apply_of_bounded hb z w
target_source: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (ω₁ ω₂ : ℂ), Differentiable ℂ f → ω₁ ≠ 0 → (ω₂ / ω₁).im ≠ 0 → (∀ z, f (z + ω₁) = f z) → (∀ z, f (z + ω₂) = f z) → ∀ z w, f z = f w
